info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Service Directory Validation-spec
info.description: The Service Directory Validation API enables the submission of validation requests for service directories within the banking domain. This endpoint allows clients to upload validation data associated with specified service directories, helping ensure accuracy and compliance. Typical consumers include banking application developers and operations teams looking to maintain service integrity across various channels. By validating service entries, businesses can enhance their operational efficiency and improve customer interactions.

post.description: This endpoint is used to validate a specific service directory entry (RES-100045) in the cross-channel system. It ensures that all required fields are correctly filled and that the entry complies with the necessary standards.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to validate the cross-channel service directory for the specified resource. It contains information required for the validation process, including details necessary for the operation to be executed successfully.

200.description: Request completed successfully, validation results returned.
